No schema.org LocalBusiness JSON-LD despite 193 reviews and 40 years of history
The strongest asset - the dated repair case-study log - is buried as unstyled text instead of being organised into service and second-opinion pages

agent_readiness.notes: Findable: GBP is claimed, correct category, hours, phone, website, a Services section and owner-uploaded photos - the strongest listing among the auto shops here; robots.txt is a bare 'User-agent: *' with no restrictions. Answerable: services, history, owner name and even dated repair outcomes are written as real text, but there is no schema JSON-LD at all, no price ranges, and the meta description does not describe the business. Bookable: nothing - no form or calendar, so a customer's agent would have to call.

operations_signals.signal: Every job starts with a phone call; there is no online appointment or estimate request
Owner personally handles second-opinion diagnostics and writes up the outcome of each job, which is a recurring manual documentation load (inference)
Google reviews highlight communication and being kept updated during repairs - a workflow that currently depends on staff time

top_opportunities.opportunity: Add an online appointment and second-opinion request form with photo/estimate upload
top_opportunities.evidence: No form or booking element anywhere on the site; the only CTA is a tel: link, and the shop's whole pitch is winning second opinions from dealer quotes

top_opportunities.opportunity: Rebuild the site around service pages and the existing case-study archive, with LocalBusiness JSON-LD and proper titles/descriptions
top_opportunities.evidence: Copyright 2018, meta description is 'FULL SERVICE AUTO REPAIR', only one service page ('Suspension'), zero JSON-LD blocks, and the valuable repair log is unformatted text

top_opportunities.opportunity: Review-request automation and status-update messaging for jobs in progress
top_opportunities.evidence: 193 reviews at 4.5 with reviewers repeatedly praising being kept updated - currently a manual staff task

scores.reasons: Gap: strong reputation and claimed profile but a site frozen in 2018 with no booking, no schema and one service page. Pay: established 40-year shop with 193 reviews and salaried technicians. Ease: content already exists (case studies) and the fixes are conventional. Evidence: site interviewed in desktop and mobile, GBP, robots.txt and JSON-LD count all verified.

caveats: Review counts on Google Maps were not visible in the limited (non-signed-in) view for Master Carpet Cleaner, Home Maids Pro, Hortensia, Neatly Yours, Bio-Tech, Giancola Brothers and Giancola's Auto Body; counts shown are from the listing where available and from Angi where noted.

Three businesses in this batch are headquartered outside East Brunswick (Hortensia in Middlesex NJ, Neatly Yours in NYC, Bio-Tech in Staten Island with a Freehold NJ address). They appear in East Brunswick only as service-area or directory listings; treat town match as unconfirmed.

Giancola Brothers Inc and Giancola's Auto Body Repairs are treated as separate businesses because Google lists them at different addresses and phone numbers. Their relationship is an inference from the shared surname and branding, not a documented fact.
data_gaps: Google review counts for most listings could not be read without signing in; only Pete's (18) and Gibraltar (193) exposed counts in the public view.

DuckDuckGo search returned a bot challenge and one Bing attempt returned irrelevant results, so no additional cross-check of ratings beyond Google Maps, Angi, BBB and Yelp-style directories was possible.
No staffing or headcount data was available for any business except Pete's (~2 employees, third-party Manta listing) and Gibraltar (salaried employees, unnamed count).

Sweeney's status rests on a single Google 'Permanently closed' flag plus the absence of any surviving towing listing; the business's own website still advertises services and no closure notice was found, so closure was not independently confirmed by the owner.
Bio-Tech Restoration's New Jersey office (330 Mounts Corner Drive, Suite 214, Freehold per Angi) could not be verified on Google; a different company now appears at that street address.
